items.text: I understand the fear of war and the pain of division that afflict this continent--and I pledge

items.title: ENGLISH SPEECH | RONALD REAGAN: Tear Down This Wall! (English Subtitles)
items.text: namely, the elimination of such weapons on both sides.

items.title: ENGLISH SPEECH | RONALD REAGAN: Tear Down This Wall! (English Subtitles)
items.text: For many months, the Soviets refused to bargain in earnestness. As the alliance, in turn, prepared

items.title: ENGLISH SPEECH | RONALD REAGAN: Tear Down This Wall! (English Subtitles)
items.text: like those during my 1982 visit to this city--and the Soviets later walked away from the table.

items.title: ENGLISH SPEECH | RONALD REAGAN: Tear Down This Wall! (English Subtitles)
items.text: But through it all, the alliance held firm. And I invite those who protested then--I

items.title: ENGLISH SPEECH | RONALD REAGAN: Tear Down This Wall! (English Subtitles)
items.text: But through it all, the alliance held firm. And I invite those who protested then--I

items.title: ENGLISH SPEECH | RONALD REAGAN: Tear Down This Wall! (English Subtitles)
items.text: invite those who protest today--to mark this fact: Because we remained strong,

items.title: ENGLISH SPEECH | RONALD REAGAN: Tear Down This Wall! (English Subtitles)
items.text: At the talks in Geneva, we have also proposed deep cuts in strategic offensive weapons.

items.title: ENGLISH SPEECH | RONALD REAGAN: Tear Down This Wall! (English Subtitles)
items.text: And the Western allies have likewise made far-reaching proposals

items.title: ENGLISH SPEECH | RONALD REAGAN: Tear Down This Wall! (English Subtitles)
items.text: to reduce the danger of conventional war and to place a total ban on chemical weapons.

items.title: ENGLISH SPEECH | RONALD REAGAN: Tear Down This Wall! (English Subtitles)
items.text: While we pursue these arms reductions, I pledge to you that we will maintain

items.title: ENGLISH SPEECH | RONALD REAGAN: Tear Down This Wall! (English Subtitles)
items.text: the capacity to deter Soviet aggression at any level at which it might occur.

items.title: ENGLISH SPEECH | RONALD REAGAN: Tear Down This Wall! (English Subtitles)
items.text: And in cooperation with many of our allies, the United States is pursuing the Strategic

items.title: ENGLISH SPEECH | RONALD REAGAN: Tear Down This Wall! (English Subtitles)
items.text: mistrust each other because we are armed; we are armed because we mistrust each other.

items.title: ENGLISH SPEECH | RONALD REAGAN: Tear Down This Wall! (English Subtitles)
items.text: And our differences are not about weapons but about liberty. When President Kennedy

items.title: ENGLISH SPEECH | RONALD REAGAN: Tear Down This Wall! (English Subtitles)
items.text: In Europe, only one nation and those it controls refuse to join the community of freedom.

items.title: ENGLISH SPEECH | RONALD REAGAN: Tear Down This Wall! (English Subtitles)
items.text: Yet in this age of redoubled economic growth, of information and innovation,

items.title: ENGLISH SPEECH | RONALD REAGAN: Tear Down This Wall! (English Subtitles)
items.text: the Soviet Union faces a choice: It must make fundamental changes, or it will become obsolete.

items.title: ENGLISH SPEECH | RONALD REAGAN: Tear Down This Wall! (English Subtitles)
items.text: Today thus represents a moment of hope. We in the West stand ready to cooperate with the East

items.title: ENGLISH SPEECH | RONALD REAGAN: Tear Down This Wall! (English Subtitles)
items.text: the meeting place of East and West, to make a start.

items.text: And I invite Mr. Gorbachev: Let us work to bring the Eastern and Western parts

items.title: ENGLISH SPEECH | RONALD REAGAN: Tear Down This Wall! (English Subtitles)
items.text: than to offer in some future year to hold the Olympic games here in Berlin, East and West?

items.title: ENGLISH SPEECH | RONALD REAGAN: Tear Down This Wall! (English Subtitles)
items.text: In these four decades, as I have said, you Berliners have built a great city.

items.title: ENGLISH SPEECH | RONALD REAGAN: Tear Down This Wall! (English Subtitles)
items.text: You've done so in spite of threats--the Soviet attempts to impose the East-mark, the blockade.

items.title: ENGLISH SPEECH | RONALD REAGAN: Tear Down This Wall! (English Subtitles)

items.title: ENGLISH SPEECH | RONALD REAGAN: Tear Down This Wall! (English Subtitles)
